Title: Tom-Fu/You Can't Handle the Tooth/Pain for Sale
Writer: Jason Plapp, Jim Praytor, Robert Zappia
Actors: Robbie Daymond, Grey Griffin, Tom Kenny
Plot: After an unsuccessful attempt on Tom's part to catch Jerry, a traveling cat salesman is happy to sell Tom just what he needs; a series of elaborate mousetraps, tricks, and schemes. Tom attempts to dish out a world of hurt to Jerry.
